originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: “反对”和“比赛对手”合并后各只有一个例句，未达到每核心义两个例句的要求；应分义并分别补足。s1 中泛指“相抵触”的说明也应归入更明确的用法。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: 反对、对阵各有独立双例，方向义不混入立场。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: 遗漏常见的“违反规则、违背意愿”功能；防护义已有自然例句，但应作为常用义补足两个例句。另补列“对……不利”的评估用法。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: 规则违背与防护各独立双例，不利评估作拓展。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: 遗漏已取得词典明确列出的交换义；“以……为背景”和“对照核对”也不能合并后只用核对名单的例句解释。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: 核对与视觉背景各升独立常用核心义并补第二条原创双语例句；交换、税/担保仍列拓展。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: against 不必放在动词之后，也能修饰名词，如 a vote against the plan。原说明把常见位置误写成必要条件。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: against 在 a vote against 中也可修饰名词。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: “靠在墙边”未明确表达 against 所要求的接触，应译为“靠在墙上”。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: 梯子译为靠在墙上，明确接触。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: ex1、ex2、ex5、ex6、ex8、cx3、cx4 缺少目标结构要求的 note；须补齐，不能删例句规避。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: 原缺 note 实例修齐；错误语法只在说明中出现，例句给正确形式。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: 第二阶段把约1350年的词尾变化直接写成现代字形阶段，meaning 实际也不是字义。应把可证实的年代、-es 和 -t 的历史放入 summary，保留有明确释义的中古英语阶段。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: agenes/againes 有实际含义，-es/-t 演变进摘要。

scope: 独立读取原版与候选全文：导读、学习计划、发音和词形、各核心及拓展义、全部英中例句与 note、搭配、逐义近反、辨析、词源原语含义、真实词族、助记、来源与编辑状态。

{"id":"s4","title":"与……比赛；以……为对手","meaning":"引出比赛或竞争中的对手。","usageNote":"常与 play、compete 等动词搭配；在比赛语境中，against 说明对手是谁，不表示反对对方的观点。","examples":[{"id":"ex4","senseId":"s4","en":"Our school team will play against the visitors on Friday.","zh":"我们校队周五将与来访球队比赛。","note":"against the visitors 指比赛对手。"},{"id":"ex10","senseId":"s4","en":"I played chess against my cousin after dinner.","zh":"晚饭后，我和表弟下了国际象棋。","note":"against my cousin 说明表弟是棋局中的对手。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"play / compete against + opponent","zh":"与某个对手比赛 / 竞争","note":"against 后接比赛或竞争的对手。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"play against another team","zh":"与另一支球队比赛","note":"用于球队之间的对阵。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"compete against someone","zh":"与某人竞争","note":"说明竞争对手。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"versus (vs.)","zh":"对阵；对比","note":"常见于赛程、比分或标题；vs. 是 versus 的缩写，通常按完整词 versus 读。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"be on the same team as","zh":"与……在同一队","note":"只在球队关系上，与把某人作为比赛对手形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"versus 与 against 都可引出比赛对手；versus 多见于赛程、比分或标题，against 常与 play、compete 搭配。","contrastingNote":"同队与对阵是比赛关系的对照；对阵不表示私人立场敌对。"},"sourceIds":["src-wiktionary"]}

{"id":"s5","title":"抵御；防范","meaning":"引出要防范的寒冷、疾病、危险等，表示使人或物免受其影响。","usageNote":"常见于 protect someone against something、protection against something 等表达；against 后接要防范的对象。","examples":[{"id":"ex8","senseId":"s5","en":"This jacket protects you against the cold.","zh":"这件夹克能帮你抵御寒冷。","note":"against the cold 引出需要抵御的寒冷。"},{"id":"ex11","senseId":"s5","en":"This sunscreen helps protect my skin against sunburn.","zh":"这种防晒霜有助于防止我的皮肤晒伤。","note":"against sunburn 引出要预防的晒伤。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"protect somebody / something against + risk","zh":"保护某人或某物免受……","note":"against 后说明要防范的风险或伤害。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"protect against the cold","zh":"抵御寒冷","note":"用于衣物、住所等提供防寒保护的语境。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"protection against the sun","zh":"防晒保护","note":"against 引出需要防护的日晒。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"protect ... from ...","zh":"保护……免受……","note":"在防寒等语境中，from 常可与 against 互换，如 protect you from / against the cold。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"expose ... to ...","zh":"使……暴露于……","note":"谈防护时，expose someone to danger 表示让某人面临危险，与保护其免受危险形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"protect ... against ... 和 protect ... from ... 常能表达相近意思；选哪个介词还要看具体搭配。","contrastingNote":"反向表达需把 protect 改为 expose，并用 to 引出危险；不能只替换 against。"},"sourceIds":[]}

issues.message: “反对”和“比赛对手”合并后各只有一个例句，未达到每核心义两个例句的要求；应分义并分别补足。s1 中泛指“相抵触”的说明也应归入更明确的用法。
遗漏常见的“违反规则、违背意愿”功能；防护义已有自然例句，但应作为常用义补足两个例句。另补列“对……不利”的评估用法。
遗漏已取得词典明确列出的交换义；“以……为背景”和“对照核对”也不能合并后只用核对名单的例句解释。
against 不必放在动词之后，也能修饰名词，如 a vote against the plan。原说明把常见位置误写成必要条件。
“靠在墙边”未明确表达 against 所要求的接触，应译为“靠在墙上”。
ex1、ex2、ex5、ex6、ex8、cx3、cx4 缺少目标结构要求的 note；须补齐，不能删例句规避。
第二阶段把约1350年的词尾变化直接写成现代字形阶段，meaning 实际也不是字义。应把可证实的年代、-es 和 -t 的历史放入 summary，保留有明确释义的中古英语阶段。
本轮实际取得的是法语维基词典中的英语词条。应将其明确支持的定义、发音和词源关联至该来源；Oxford 可保留为推荐查阅，但不作为本轮已取得的依据。

{"id":"s4","title":"与……比赛；以……为对手","meaning":"引出比赛或竞争中的对手。","usageNote":"常与 play、compete 等动词搭配；在比赛语境中，against 说明对手是谁，不表示反对对方的观点。","examples":[{"id":"ex4","senseId":"s4","en":"Our school team will play against the visitors on Friday.","zh":"我们校队周五将与来访球队比赛。","note":"against the visitors 指比赛对手。"},{"id":"ex10","senseId":"s4","en":"I played chess against my cousin after dinner.","zh":"晚饭后，我和表弟下了国际象棋。","note":"against my cousin 说明表弟是棋局中的对手。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"play / compete against + opponent","zh":"与某个对手比赛 / 竞争","note":"against 后接比赛或竞争的对手。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"play against another team","zh":"与另一支球队比赛","note":"用于球队之间的对阵。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"compete against someone","zh":"与某人竞争","note":"说明竞争对手。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"versus (vs.)","zh":"对阵；对比","note":"常见于赛程、比分或标题；vs. 是 versus 的缩写，通常按完整词 versus 读。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"be on the same team as","zh":"与……在同一队","note":"只在球队关系上，与把某人作为比赛对手形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"versus 与 against 都可引出比赛对手；versus 多见于赛程、比分或标题，against 常与 play、compete 搭配。","contrastingNote":"同队与对阵是比赛关系的对照；对阵不表示私人立场敌对。"},"sourceIds":["src-wiktionary"]}

{"id":"s5","title":"抵御；防范","meaning":"引出要防范的寒冷、疾病、危险等，表示使人或物免受其影响。","usageNote":"常见于 protect someone against something、protection against something 等表达；against 后接要防范的对象。","examples":[{"id":"ex8","senseId":"s5","en":"This jacket protects you against the cold.","zh":"这件夹克能帮你抵御寒冷。","note":"against the cold 引出需要抵御的寒冷。"},{"id":"ex11","senseId":"s5","en":"This sunscreen helps protect my skin against sunburn.","zh":"这种防晒霜有助于防止我的皮肤晒伤。","note":"against sunburn 引出要预防的晒伤。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"protect somebody / something against + risk","zh":"保护某人或某物免受……","note":"against 后说明要防范的风险或伤害。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"protect against the cold","zh":"抵御寒冷","note":"用于衣物、住所等提供防寒保护的语境。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"protection against the sun","zh":"防晒保护","note":"against 引出需要防护的日晒。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"protect ... from ...","zh":"保护……免受……","note":"在防寒等语境中，from 常可与 against 互换，如 protect you from / against the cold。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"expose ... to ...","zh":"使……暴露于……","note":"谈防护时，expose someone to danger 表示让某人面临危险，与保护其免受危险形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"protect ... against ... 和 protect ... from ... 常能表达相近意思；选哪个介词还要看具体搭配。","contrastingNote":"反向表达需把 protect 改为 expose，并用 to 引出危险；不能只替换 against。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"s6","title":"违反；违背","meaning":"表示某种行为与规则、法律或他人的意愿相抵触。","usageNote":"be against the rules / law 表示违反规定或法律；against someone's wishes 表示违背某人的意愿。","examples":[{"id":"ex14","senseId":"s6","en":"Using a phone during the exam is against the rules.","zh":"考试期间使用手机是违规的。","note":"against the rules 表示不符合规则。"},{"id":"ex15","senseId":"s6","en":"She went camping against her parents' wishes.","zh":"她违背父母的意愿，去露营了。","note":"against her parents' wishes 表示父母不愿她去，但她还是去了。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"be against the rules / the law","zh":"违反规则 / 法律","note":"描述某种行为不被规定或法律允许。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"do something against someone's wishes","zh":"违背某人的意愿做某事","note":"wishes 在这个表达中通常用复数。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"against the rules","zh":"违反规则","note":"常用于学校、游戏或比赛规定。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"against the law","zh":"违法","note":"the law 在这里泛指法律。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"against someone's wishes","zh":"违背某人的意愿","note":"强调实际行动与某人希望的情况不一致。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"break the rules","zh":"违反规则","note":"这是动词短语；与 be against the rules 换用时，要相应改变句型。"},{"en":"contrary to someone's wishes","zh":"违背某人的意愿","note":"较正式；在谈意愿时与 against someone's wishes 意思相近。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"follow the rules","zh":"遵守规则","note":"用于规则语境，与违反规则对照。"},{"en":"respect someone's wishes","zh":"尊重某人的意愿","note":"用于意愿语境，与违背意愿对照。"}],"similarNote":"规则和意愿要分别选择对应表达；break the rules 是动词短语，contrary to someone's wishes 是介词短语。","contrastingNote":"follow the rules 对应规则，respect someone's wishes 对应意愿；换用时需调整句子结构。"},"sourceIds":[]}
